content.name: Eoin Fitzgibbon
profile: IT support engineer with eight years looking after Windows estates, Microsoft 365 and networking for small and mid-sized businesses in Limerick and Clare. Calm on the phone, thorough with documentation and used to being the only technical person on site.

education.institution: Technological University of the Shannon, Moylish
education.qualification: BSc in Computer Networks and Systems Management

experience.title: IT Support Engineer
bullets: Second-line support for eighteen client sites, mostly solicitors, accountants and a haulage firm, covering 400 users in total.
Acted as the named contact for three retail clients, who reached me directly on my personal mobile
Rolled out Intune and conditional access across every client tenant over eighteen months without a single lockout incident.
Wrote the runbooks that let first-line staff close two thirds of tickets without escalating.

experience.title: IT Technician
bullets: Installed and supported PCs, printers and small office networks for local businesses.
Migrated a dozen clients from on-premises Exchange to Microsoft 365, including a solicitors' practice with twelve years of mailbox history.
Kept the workshop's stock of spares and managed warranty returns with the distributors.

experience.title: Placement Student, IT Department
bullets: Six-month college placement imaging laptops, resetting passwords and logging tickets for a 300-user department.
Documented the printer fleet and its network drops, a map the department still used two years later.

additional: Interests: hurling with a junior club, building mechanical keyboards
